notes: New: added an offline Library section for playing music already on your device, alongside Radio, TV, and Podcasts. Improved: the playback buffer now adapts automatically to your connection instead of one fixed size for everyone, so slow connections stall less and fast ones stay closer to live. Improved: station and TV channel lists now refresh themselves in the background roughly twice a day even when the app isn't open. Improved: brought back a manual 'Refresh station & channel lists now' option in Settings.
